title: Riverbend Medical Hardship Assistance — Hardship Liability Cap Schedule
content:
### Schedule

1. **Effective date.** For a Medical Hardship award determined on or after 2025-10-01, the date this schedule took effect, and only for such an award, the hardship liability cap is worked out as stated here; every other hardship cap remains the tier's hardship liability cap percent of annual household income, rounded half-up to the cent.
2. **Cap percent.** The cap percent is the hardship liability cap percent of the Riverbend Medical Hardship Assistance (above 400% FPL) tier of the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care).
3. **Cap.** The hardship liability cap is the annual household income recorded on the case scaled at the cap percent, the product being rounded half-up to the cent; the cap is never below zero.

### Worked example (hypothetical; cap percent taken as 10 percent)

| Annual household income recorded on the case | Income scaled at 10 percent | Cap (rounded half-up to the cent) |
|---|---|---|
| 90,000.00 | 9,000.00 | 9,000.00 |
| 91,234.55 | 9,123.455 | 9,123.46 |
